component: Exchange service and protocol registration rename

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The shared classes become ExchangeService and ExchangeProtocolHandler, while registered message-service aliases still cover ews, graph, their message schemes and their internal schemes. NS_CreateEwsProtocolHandler and NS_CreateGraphProtocolHandler remain distinct factory entry points and initialize x-moz-ews or x-moz-graph. GetUrlForUri maps each message scheme to the matching internal scheme. A class rename does not itself migrate these external identifiers; no compiled ABI or live protocol result is claimed.
title: The Exchange protocol rename retains protocol-specific factories and URI schemes
